Sompo is hiring an Assistant Pricing Developer for its Pricing and Analytics team. The role supports the migration and enhancement of commercial insurance pricing models on the HX Renew platform, including model development, testing, maintenance, and data analysis in collaboration with actuaries, underwriters, and pricing developers.
Health Insurance
Property & Casualty Insurance
Insurance
Risk Management
H1B Sponsor Likely
Responsibilities
Pricing Model Development: Help migrate Excel models on to HX Renew and enhance existing HX Renew models. This includes calculation logic, model data structures, validations, model configuration, and supporting third party integrations via APIs
User Interface Development: Support the development and maintenance of user-facing model components in HX Renew, including basic JavaScript-based custom components, with guidance from experienced developers
Model Maintenance and Troubleshooting: Investigate calculation issues, trace data through model inputs and outputs, and make controlled changes to existing models with guidance from experienced developers
Testing and Model Controls Develop test cases, reconcile results against approved calculations, investigate discrepancies, and document model changes before release
Business Collaboration: Work with Pricing Developers, Actuaries, and Underwriters to understand pricing requirements and translate them into clearly defined model changes
Python and Data Analysis: Use Python and pandas to clean, transform, validate, and analyze insurance data. Work with Excel files and SQL-based data where applicable
